text:
eva.partnerships: Heads-up — NVIDIA just flagged a possible H200 driver OTA delay (~2 weeks). We need to decide marketplace announcement sequencing for H200 / B200 / MI300 / Gaudi. Can folks weigh in on downstream impacts: SI onboarding, marketplace images, press embargo?
sam.platform: How firm is the 2-week estimate? If it slides, we should consider staggering the marketplace listing vs press.
tim.eng-runtime: If drivers land late, our runtime compatibility matrix will show regressions for some kernels. I'll queue a quick canary regression on the staging cluster.
clare.marketplace: We had a full joint announce penciled for week of May 9. If H200 moves, I propose announcing MI300 + Gaudi first and doing H200 in a follow-up wave. Embargo handling will differ per vendor — need signoff.
nvidia.evangelist: Confirming the 2-week is tentative. Will update by EOW when we lock the driver candidate. We are ok with a staggered announce. Need final cutoff for marketplace assets (images, SKUs, docs): May 3.
eva.partnerships: OK — action items from this thread: (1) Tim: run canary tests and report regressions by EOD; (2) Clare: freeze marketplace assets by May 3; (3) Sam: prepare phased release config + routing policy; (4) I will update vendor comms and marketing. Anything missing?
tim.eng-runtime: Canary started -> job `run-infer-canary-1765`
logs: https://ci.redwood/example/run/1765
Expect results ~4h.
clare.marketplace: Noted. Also need a definitive SKU tag naming convention for B200 lab images so ops can stage. Proposal: `b200-v1`, `h200-v1-preview`, `mi300-v2`. Thoughts?
sam.platform: Sounds good. I will create a feature toggle `announce.phased_hardware_rollout` and default it ON for the marketplace. ETA for config + routing changes: May 2.
nvidia.evangelist: :thumbsup: pushing a driver build candidate tonight. Will ping this thread when CI goes green or if there's a blocker.
eva.partnerships: If CI fails, fallback plan is to list H100 and MI300 as GA, keep H200 as "preview" in marketplace (no press mention). Agreed?
clare.marketplace: Agree — we'll prepare two sets of marketing copy: full GA and preview-only. Also will stage the marketplace UI toggle to show preview badge.
tim.eng-runtime: If we see kernel regressions we can hot-path to a quantized model variant for H200 preview images to reduce kernel footprint while we debug.
sam.platform: Adding a note: routing policy must map "preview" SKUs -> Dedicated capacity only and disable public rate-limits by default. I'll add docs for SIs.
eva.partnerships: Thanks all — I will summarize and push to vendors + marketing. Please update this thread with final EOW driver status so we have a single source of truth for the embargo decision.
